indicator_name: Share of money income by population decile, annual
description: Доля денежных доходов по 10-процентным (децильным) группам населения, годовая
methodology: Deciles of the population ranked by per-capita money income. 2011-2021 Taldau 704515, 2022-2025 the annual editions (equal to Taldau where both exist). Shares add to 100 each year (checked). Taldau 704515 fills the periods no edition covers; on the 30 overlapping points it differs from the editions in 0 -- the editions are kept. Editions read: 37365 2022, 179025 2023, 341348 2024, 341349 2025.
